screens.name: J08 / review / Before you leave.
screens.text:
9:41                                      ▰  ▮▮  ▰
fancy
Before you leave.
Deleting your account will sign you out and hide your public profile and content.

Upcoming meals you host will be cancelled. You’ll leave upcoming meals and pending applications. Your contact consent, group access, AI preferences and active context will be removed.

Other members’ participation in meals already started is preserved. Remaining provider and content removal continues afterward under the approved policy.
Continue to verify identity
Keep my account

Verify using your existing linked identity. You’ll return to this deletion request; verification does not submit it.

123456
Your identity check must be within 5 minutes when you submit. Linked Google/Apple use their existing identity flow.
Verify identity
Keep my account

screens.text:

Delete your account?
You’ll be signed out once the request is accepted. Remaining removal steps may still be processing. You cannot use a receipt or public reference to restore your account.
Confirmation
☑ I understand the account-deletion consequences.
Request account deletion
Keep my account

Check original request

screens.name: J08 / pending / Your request is accepted.
screens.text:
9:41                                      ▰  ▮▮  ▰
fancy
Your request is accepted.
Pending

Account access is closed. Public content is hidden and new participation or contact has stopped. Remaining removal steps are pending. This does not mean removal is complete.

Public reference: SYN-DEL-01
Check progress

screens.name: J08 / processing / Removal is processing.
screens.text:
9:41                                      ▰  ▮▮  ▰
fancy
Removal is processing.
Processing

Completed steps are retained. Remaining provider, content and data-removal steps continue. This page uses your saved private receipt; you do not need to sign in.

Public reference: SYN-DEL-01
Check progress
Contact support

Status is temporarily unavailable.
Your saved receipt is kept. Retry checking the original request or contact support. Account access stays closed; no new deletion is created.
Check progress again
Contact support
